description: Branch-only boundary fix. Functional/files: migrate branch-added Answering/Factory and portal runtime credential reads whose System wrappers now execute Connect; separate pure config reads from credential resolution; move branch-added AI provider configuration mutation orchestration behind an Engine domain action so BO/Onboarding/UserPortal callers do not execute Connect locally. Preserve transaction atomicity, encryption, mutation jobs, DTO/error contracts and existing global behavior. Tests first: consumers dispatch exact actions, Engine-unavailable failures, create/update rollback and notification atomicity, no direct Connect aliases/calls in off-role new code. Mock NodeRouter only; internal Engine dependencies real. Docs update. Action reuse: REUSE existing system-config get actions where contracts suffice; EXTEND Engine API with a focused atomic provisioning operation where existing CRUD cannot preserve the transaction; no generic invoke/tool exposure.
title: Route branch-added credential consumers and provisioning
